command:
set -eu
NODE2_IP=$(printf '%s\n' "$CLUSTER_HOSTS" | awk '$2=="node2" {print $1; exit}')
[ -n "$NODE2_IP" ]
cp -a /etc/rsyncd.conf /etc/rsyncd.conf.pre-releases
cat > /etc/rsyncd.conf <<EOF
address = $NODE_IP
port = 873
pid file = /run/rsyncd.pid
lock file = /run/rsyncd.lock
log file = /var/log/rsyncd.log
uid = nobody
gid = nobody
use chroot = yes
read only = yes
list = yes
max connections = 10
timeout = 300
hosts allow = $NODE2_IP
hosts deny = *

[releases]
    path = /srv/legacy2/rsync-module-publication/releases
    comment = Approved legacy release tree
    read only = yes
    use chroot = yes
EOF
cat > /etc/systemd/system/rsyncd.service <<'EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Rsync daemon for approved release publication
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/bin/rsync --daemon --no-detach --config=/etc/rsyncd.conf
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=2s

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
restorecon -v /etc/rsyncd.conf /etc/systemd/system/rsyncd.service
setsebool -P rsync_export_all_ro on
firewall-cmd --permanent --add-rich-rule="rule family=ipv4 source address=$NODE2_IP/32 port port=873 protocol=tcp accept"
firewall-cmd --reload
systemctl daemon-reload
systemctl enable --now rsyncd.service
